newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan must be vigilant on stock market trend - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan must be vigilant on stock market trend - MITI.

text.p: Japan must keep careful watch over the trend of the stock market, Trade Minister Shinji Sato said on Friday.
"Japan must watch the stock market trend with caution," he said at a news conference.
Asked if cabinet ministers discussed possible remedies for the recent Tokyo stock market tumble, he said "no".
Japanese stocks took another battering on Friday, with the market's key Nikkei 225 share index down by more than 400 points to around 17,600 by midday.
